name: Surfel Parameterization from Mesh Sampling
definition: A procedure to estimate surfel parameters (tangent vectors and scales) for a point cloud sampled from a triangle mesh, where point positions and face normals are obtained directly from sampling, and remaining parameters are estimated from the local neighborhood structure.
summary: Surfel Parameterization from Mesh Sampling estimates surfel parameters from triangle meshes by deriving tangent scales from local point cloud neighborhoods rather than mesh connectivity.
